name: sim-ws-backpressure
notes: The API.md §6.5 slow-consumer ladder, every rung, on a replay. GENERATED by providers/sim/prng.ts for the reason TESTING §8 records for sim-ws-burst: a single recorded poll cannot produce a second observation, so a session with a live feed behind a stalling socket cannot be recorded. Two subjects at 10 Hz; the thresholds are scaled down (512 B soft, 4 KiB hard, 500 ms grace, 500 ms ceiling) so that the ladder is walked in four seconds of virtual time instead of the ten seconds production waits — the RUNGS are the shipped ones, only the byte, grace and ceiling numbers are session parameters, and no budget is relaxed. The buffered events are the socket: 1 000 B crosses soft and widens 250 ms to 500 ms, 5 000 B crosses hard and the flush is skipped with the dirty set retained, the grace expires once and sheds the non-essential subject (q:3, off-viewport), expires again and warns disconnect-soon, then the socket drains to 0 and three consecutive quiet flushes restore the interval.
